description: Present a gift to another Sim via their pie menu's Give Gift / Gift entry. Prerequisite: target exposes a gift entry on the live pie menu (typically gated on having an appropriate inventory item; in TSO classic, gifts draw from the giver's inventory). Effect: queues the resolved interaction; on completion the gift object transfers from your inventory to the target and shifts their relationship to you upward on friendship (and sometimes romance if the gift is themed). Cost: in-sim minutes; queue slot; and the inventory item consumed by the gift — non-recoverable without an explicit return/take-back from the recipient.

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: Persist ID of the target Sim.

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: Local ObjectID of the target Sim.

call_signatures: cf $CF give-gift --target_object_id <object_id>                                     # alternate; must resolve to a VMAvatar
common_mistakes: Directed socials (be-friendly/flirt/tell-joke/be-mean/give-gift) resolve target pie-menu by ALIAS substring; if the target's pie menu has no matching entry the handler returns ok=false with the list of available names — read the error to pick a different verb.
Passing --target_object_id for a non-avatar object silently fails these socials (they require VMAvatar target).
Speak rejects leading '/' — that prefix is reserved for admin chat commands; use admin-chat-command instead.
perception_hints: Target's current action (to judge if they're busy): perception.nearby_sims[].current_action
Your social motive (why this matters): perception.motives.social.value
refuse_conditions: no matching pie-menu entry → ok:false with available-names list
